intro.text: A lanky twenty-one-year-old who hunts nightmares, and who wakes one day in a strange place looking like a girl named Yumi.
Nikaro, usually called Painter, a nightmare painter of Kilahito who fell in love with the yoki-hijo Yumi and helped free her.

items.text: Painter grew up in a small town a few hours from Kilahito, practicing art from the time he could hold a brush and dreaming of joining the Dreamwatch with his friends. A year into training he applied and was rejected, but told his friends he had been accepted. When they discovered the lie, the friendships ended; he kept painting alone, though Akane stayed friendly.

Walking home after work, the young man spotted signs of a nightmare and, though off shift, tracked it to a family's home, where he found a nearly full stable nightmare and drove it off. He fainted and woke in a strange place beside a girl named Yumi. Concluding he had come from the daystar, he found he had taken on Yumi's appearance and unknowingly broke her rituals when her attendants fed him.

When Yumi grew angry, he convinced her he was not a spirit, falsely claiming to be a hero sent to fix the problem with the spirits. Liyun did not believe his explanation, so he apologized as Yumi instructed. They found they could not move more than ten feet apart, and touching caused a sharp, electric sensation that also seemed to swap emotions. Exhausted, he fell asleep and woke in his own apartment.

Now Yumi was in his world, looking like herself, and he was the incorporeal one. She answered his door to Foreman Sukishi and said he was sick and hunting a stable nightmare, then met his neighbor Akane, mistaking her for one of his concubines. Afterward Yumi realized he was no hero and was furious with him, until she fell asleep and they woke in her world again.

Following Yumi's instructions, he apologized to Liyun for collapsing, growing annoyed at how Yumi treated him. A staring contest during the ritual bath earned him some respect. At the village shrine Yumi had him say the six ritual prayers, poking him to keep him awake, and he tried and badly failed to stack stones.

Back in Painter's world, Yumi decided she would have to teach him. Painter insisted they check on the stable nightmare and the family, but Foreman Sukishi, who knew of Painter's old lie and scorned his endless bamboo paintings, would not believe them. Returning home, they met Akane, who offered to help Yumi, and Yumi gratefully accepted.

Painter trailed along as Yumi went shopping with Akane and then to the Noodle Pupil with Akane's friends Izzy, Tojin and Masaka, keeping away from his old friends. Design, seeing him, dropped a bowl of noodles thinking he was dead. They explained their situation, and Design said Yumi was very Invested and promised to help, though it was more Hoid's area, and Hoid was frozen in time.

In Yumi's world, Painter was irritated by Yumi's strictness just as they seemed to be connecting. Through him, Yumi told Liyun they would need time to restore her skills, then began teaching him to find each stone's center of gravity and balance it, warning that it would take days.

Back in his world, Painter experimented with controlling the souls of his clothing while Yumi learned to heat the room through the thermostat's Hion lines. He thought it unwise for Yumi to seek the stable nightmare. A letter placed him on a month's unpaid leave for neglecting his duties, and he began teaching Yumi to paint bamboo in case of emergency.

After eleven days of training, Painter managed a few small stacks and admitted Yumi's lessons helped. Watching her passion as she stacked alongside him, he began to grasp how hard her life had been and to empathize with her. Then scholars from the Institute of Mechanical Solutions arrived in Torio with a machine that could stack rocks.

Though Yumi was angry once she learned Painter had lied about being a hero, the two gradually learned to work together, helping each other through their troubles and teaching each other how to live in their worlds. Along the way, they fell in love.
Masaka, a quiet member of Painter's old group of friends who had once made him a birthday hat, helped Painter and Yumi map the outside world, though Painter was invisible to her at the time.

Painter, who had long found Liyun too controlling but slowly warmed to her, learned that she was the stable nightmare he had met just before meeting Yumi. He asked her to give Yumi a picture, and after some persuasion she agreed to try.

With Kilahito in danger, Painter begged Akane and his old friends for forgiveness and help. Tojin, whom he had saved from a stable nightmare while bodiless, agreed first and convinced a reluctant Izzy. Fighting together in the battle of Kilahito, they forgave him; Tojin was the first after Painter to cry "We are the dreamwatch now," and Painter saved Izzy with a drawn bird when she froze.

appearance.text: He is a lanky twenty-one-year-old with shoulder-length black hair, kept long because he thinks it is easier and more impressive. He looks Veden but with unusually pale skin, and wears an untucked shirt and a knee-length cloak. He tells himself he is a happy lone hunter, but secretly hopes his old friends will invite him back.

personality.text: Painter was the best artist of his year, and Akane calls him the most talented she has ever seen. Yumi at first thought him lazy, but was amazed by the masterpieces in his portfolio. After failing to join the Dreamwatch, he painted almost nothing but bamboo, claiming it was efficient.
